action_yolo11m.pt.source: Capstone action detector (YOLO11m), team repo capstone-action-recognition; used for serves

court_kpt.pt.source: Court keypoint model v2 (YOLO26 pose, 14 points), trained on Colab on the k6y7r Roboflow set (CC BY 4.0)

court_kpt_broadcast.pt.source: Court keypoint model v3b (YOLO26s pose), trained on Colab on k6y7r plus completed VNL broadcast frames

jersey_digits_yolo26s.pt.source: Shirt digit detector (YOLO26s), trained on three Roboflow jersey sets (CC BY 4.0), notebooks/train_jersey_digits.ipynb

person_action_yolo26s_cls.pt.source: Per-player action classifier (YOLO26s cls), trained on Kaggle on the Volleyball dataset (Ibrahim et al.), notebooks/train_person_actions.ipynb

player_yolo26s_sportsmot.pt.source: Player detector (YOLO26s), fine-tuned on Kaggle on SportsMOT volleyball training sequences (CC BY-NC 4.0, research use)

rally_cues_hgb.joblib.source: Broadcast rally classifier (scikit-learn HGB) on rally cues, scripts/eval_rallies.py --save

rally_fixed_hgb.joblib.source: Fixed-camera rally classifier (scikit-learn HGB) on stage cues and score-bug labels, scripts/train_fixed_rallies.py --save

wasb_gym.onnx.source: WASB (Tarashima et al., MIT) fine-tuned on Kaggle on gym footage, notebooks/train_ball_detector.ipynb

wasb_mixed.onnx.source: WASB (Tarashima et al., MIT) fine-tuned on Kaggle on gym and broadcast footage, notebooks/train_ball_detector.ipynb

wasb_volleyball.onnx.source: WASB published Volleyball-dataset weights (Tarashima et al., MIT) exported to ONNX, notebooks/eval_wasb_volleyball.ipynb

yolo26s.pt.source: Ultralytics YOLO26s COCO weights (AGPL-3.0); general person detector fallback
